reviews.review:
I would definatly recommend this to gamers who are into games for the experience you gain from teamwork and also those who enjoy games due to the lore aspect of games. With all the optional quest's like Stolen dreams and The Second dream you get to know a lot about not only the tenno but also the lotus, General lore is sprinkled throughout the game in the form of cephalon fragments that give you details about the grineer, corpus and orokin races. 

Talking actual gameplay there is definatly a learning and level curve (About MR 5 but changes from person to person) and once you complete the first few planets the actual grind of the game for componants and exp really sets in as you should prepare for the task of completing the starchart (Usually done by MR9-10). So whats next? you have to complete the major lore quests to complete the starchart but what do you after? The final level of the star chart is lvl45 (Ignoring Sedna's arena) and you realise that the enemys are just way to easy to beat. You will tire of the grind for better gear and look for something that is actually a challange to beat. look to the direlict and sorties then finally going on the trial missions to really complete every mission that is achievable ingame.

For those of you who arent looking for a pure PvE game dont worry there is conclave where you can use your gear to test your skill agaisnt other players or for those who arent into the whole fighting with weapons thing there is lunaro. pretty much bordenball but actually lets you bash people to gain posession of the ball.

[u]Pro's[/u]
-PvE and PvP elements that appeal to all gamer-types
-Many different weapons and warframes to choose from leave play-style up to the player
-Interesting lore for the player to search for
-Great community you can look towards if you need a little boost to get that mission done
-Good development team wo look towards the community for input on updates 
-Its a true Free Too Play (all weapons and frames are achievable without spending a penny, cosmetics not so much)

[u]Con's[/u]
-Difficult learning curve that makes the starchart difficult for new players
-Difficult warframes to master (Looking at limbo for this one)
-Boring grind to gain more exp

TL,DR - Warframe is an engaging game for all playstyle's that lets you chose how you go about doing things, putting the player before the devs. Letting everyone have their own choice of what they want to use to complete the game with a friendly community to help new players learn the basics and forgiving gameplay early on that gets harder and mercyless as you complete more of the game.

9/10 - would be easily a 10/10 if the wasnt so boring that you spend litteral hours of non stop farming just to be able to use a weapon properly.

I Recommend For Starter Warframes:

- Loki For Stealth/Spy Missions (2nd Skill)

- Ash For Exterminate Missions (3rd/4th Skill)

- Frost For Defense Missions(3rd Skill)

- Nyx for Interception Missions (3rd Skill)

- And Trinity for Tough Times 

The Game Changes With Updates For Better Or Worse, But I'd Say One Can Have Fun With It, But If The Day Comes You Attain Everything You Won't Play It As Much As At First, But Even With That Its A Solid Game.

I Rate 7-8/10.
